finding: Direct column IS NULL/IS NOT NULL masks called vectorValue for every row, decoding packed text and materializing nested containers outside the mask reservation.
fix: Resolve nullness solely through validity, null vectors, dictionary indices and union tags/offsets. Indirection is iterative; non-null leaf payload and nested container children are not read. Constant-space cycle detection preserves termination without a visited-node set.

failures: TextDecoder called four times where metadata-only checks require zero calls.
A 20000-level dictionary chain overflowed the recursive value reader.

validation.workerRetry: Default parallel-file run hit 5s timestamp dynamic-import and 15s Cloudflare entrypoint-import timeouts. Complete serialized-file rerun passed all 82 tests with existing timeouts unchanged; in-test concurrent queries remained concurrent.

evidence: Eighteen unit cases cover primitive/packed/nested/union/dictionary null semantics, both negations, exact mask capacity, one-byte-short rejection with sibling preservation, invalid indirection cleanup, deep dictionary chains, cyclic dictionary/union rejection and terminating self-aliases at different row offsets.

Real HTTP Parquet fixture matrix includes nullable text; both null predicates preserve filtered offset/limit results through borrowed/owned scanners and 206/200 responses. Owned results remain charged through cache eviction and release to zero.
Native R2 fixture matrix adds four concurrent nullable queries with cold/warm cache reuse, cache eviction while outputs remain owned, and zero cleanup at 64/128 MiB.
boundaries: A null predicate inspects nullness, not leaf payload validity; invalid union/dictionary indirection still rejects. Data decoding/validation remains the scan layer responsibility.

The benchmark reproduces the removed loop using current vectorValue, not a historical full build. Source storage is borrowed and excluded from predicate charges; the old loop had the same mask charge despite untracked payload work.
HTTP fixtures, local workerd R2 bindings and Node timing are distinct evidence; no production-cloud latency or whole-runtime heap bound is claimed.
Ordering comparisons retain their previous implementation. Broader audit and final release gates remain open.
The existing predicate mask backing-byte charge is unchanged; this removes untracked payload materialization, not every mask/view/runtime bookkeeping gap.
